Route host asset preparation through its generate_asset API, completing font/drum generation before requesting breaks because builtin breaks depend on drum headers. Keep --generate-only as the public host setup interface, and preserve default compile behavior, custom bank, fatal setup errors and environment. Validate byte-identical headers, invalidation, cache failures and cold/warm timings for that combined change. Do not import the target build driver just to run host setup.
remaining_break_generation.observed_helper_api: The current live helper exposes generate_asset(kind, root, gen, cache=None), including kind=breaks. This is an observation of unfinished source, not a checked interface contract. Use the final reviewed API.
remaining_break_generation.platform_limit: The observed builtin_identity function currently requires Linux and falls back to the original generator on other platforms. Checked integration can skip renderer compilation/rendering on a valid supported Linux hit. It alone will not remove repeated builtin rendering in native macOS host calls unless the cache owner also supplies checked native dependency discovery.
